= Footnotes in code link labels

[source,rust,subs=+macros]
----
link:https://example.org/code[Before footnote:code[Code note.] after]
https://example.org/reuse[Before footnote:code[] after]
mailto:hello@example.org[Before footnote:[Mail note.] after]
link:https://example.org/only[footnote:code[]]
----

[source,rust,linenums,subs=+macros]
----
link:https://example.org/numbered[Before footnote:[Numbered note.] after]
----

[source,rust]
----
link:https://example.org/disabled[Before footnote:[Disabled note.] after]
----
